$comment: Pre-visit discovery manifest. The WebMCP spec (W3C Web Machine Learning CG) defines no manifest format; this file follows the de-facto shape third-party crawlers and inspectors probe at /.well-known/webmcp. It mirrors the tools this site registers at runtime via document.modelContext — the runtime registration is authoritative.
name: webmcpify
description: Project site for webmcpify, an MIT-licensed agent skill that makes an existing web app agent-ready with WebMCP: inventory the app's user actions, approve a tool manifest, integrate, verify every tool in a real browser, heal, audit.

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: Returns the terminal commands to install the webmcpify skill and start the pipeline, for a given agent setup. Read-only; does not change the page.

agent.description: Install route: npx (skills CLI, any agent), plugin (Claude Code plugin marketplace), git (manual clone)

tools.name: get_pipeline_overview
tools.description: Returns the seven phases of the webmcpify pipeline (DETECT through AUDIT) with a one-line explanation each. Read-only.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Returns the FAQ of webmcpify.at (what WebMCP is, code-safety guarantees, security model, supported agents) in the currently selected page language. Read-only.

tools.name: set_language
tools.description: Switches the page language between English and German. Client-side only: updates the visible copy and stores the preference in localStorage.

tools.name: show_install_command
tools.description: Switches the install command shown in the Installation section to the variant for a given agent setup. Page-local display change; use get_install_command for the raw text.

agent.description: Install route to display: npx (skills CLI, any agent), plugin (Claude Code plugin marketplace), git (manual clone)
